yorkshire.linePrev: And that was the reason he started to roam
yorkshire.line: In Yorkshire near Rotherham, he had been on the ramble
yorkshire.lineNext: Weary of travelling, he sat down to rest
stanza: In Yorkshire near Rotherham, he had been on the ramble
Weary of travelling, he sat down to rest
By the foot of yon' mountain
With bread and cold water he himself did refresh
